summary: King County, WA tower built in the 1930s and now gone; the summit is private property with homes, and its link to a 1948 High Point Lookout report is uncertain.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com both say the tower is gone; the summit is now described as private property with homes

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives the site elevation as 1,403 ft; Willhite gives a summit elevation of 1,422 ft. Not resolved; both are reported in the story.
Register lists the Washington Division of Forestry/DNR as administrator; Willhite says the summit is private property with homes now. The sources do not say when or how ownership changed.

sources.title: Canyon Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites Register

notes_for_editor: Identity is the main open question: Willhite titles the page 'Canyon Lookout Site (maybe High Point L.O.)' and says the 1948 Mountaineers trip report is most likely about Canyon, while noting Tiger Mountain is nearby. The Kresek inventory is cited but was not read. The register gives only 'the 1930s', so no built year is recorded and no removal year is recorded. The Willhite links to the 1948 trip report and the 1936 land ownership map were not read. No web search was possible for this run (budget used up). Treat the site as private; do not list as visitable.
